Nicolson has the lowest average in the fleet, 4.30 on 23 reviews, four negatives at 17.4 per cent. It was 4.52 and 14.3 per cent in July, so this is two months above 14 per cent, not one bad week.

Volume is low and no cause dominates: three food quality issues, two each on cleanliness, speed and service. The theme is comparison. Two reviews say the food is weaker than at other branches and a four star guest calls the site "noisier, more cramped and less clean than Fountainbridge".

Watch, do not act. Derrick Cheung owns food temperature, raised twice, and the entrance greet. Ka Ho should get more reviews collected here.

quarter|2026-Q3|site|M1.t: Nicolson runs at 15.9% negative against a fleet 5.7%, the worst rate in the estate, on 44 reviews in two months, so these are small numbers. The average is 4.41 and it was 4.49 in Q2, so this is a standing position rather than a new fall. Eight of the 18 issues are food quality and five are taste, with two reviews comparing the site unfavourably with other branches: "some other locations are better food wise". Two service charge objections and two rudeness mentions complete it. Watch rather than act, but Derrick Cheung and Ka Ho should run a taste and consistency check against Fountainbridge with the Executive Chef.

I used to like this place. I've been coming here for quite a long time. It has never been a particularly cheap place either but the quality of the food was worth it, until recently that they have decided to include a 10% service charge in the bill that they do not even mention. And that's honestly absurd. A 10% mandatory tip in a culture where tipping is always voluntary is just a dangerous step toward a business model where the customer is meant to pay for the salary that the employer should be paying. I refuse to take part in this culture, and therefore, I cannot recommend this place anymore.
